purpose: 贷款实际投向旧用途及三个事前固定原季度来源核对登记，来源查询前执行
executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta
import hashlib, json, subprocess, re
root = Path.cwd()
out = root / "reports/research/510300_actual_loan_allocation_prior_use_source_v1"
def now():
    return datetime.now(timezone(timedelta(hours=8))).isoformat()
def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def rel(path):
    return str(path.relative_to(root)).replace("\\", "/")
def read(path):
    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
def save(name, value):
    p=out/name
    if p.exists():
        raise RuntimeError("来源登记已存在，禁止重复："+rel(p))
    p.write_text(json.dumps(value,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
    return {"path":rel(p),"sha256":sha(p)}
out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
if (out/"protocol.json").exists():
    raise RuntimeError("E114已登记，不重新登记")
proposal_path=root/"reports/research/510300_original_real_industrial_sales_and_base_joint_cause_source_review_v1/next_experiment.json"
proposal=read(proposal_path)
assert sha(proposal_path)=="4509a24d9280c9989640df992ffd7e16750be52a4ca10699ec9626418c85252c"
assert proposal["experiment_id"]=="E114" and proposal["status"]=="PROPOSED_NOT_REGISTERED_NOT_RUN"
prev_path=root/"reports/research/510300_original_real_industrial_sales_and_base_joint_cause_source_review_v1/result.json"
assert sha(prev_path)=="deb18ba452b07d09149b9ea11855f0f7ffd45373ffeca34e915ad32483883931"
parent_path=root/"reports/research/510300_original_collection_inventory_joint_state_decomposition_v1/全部79原身份_完整共同背景与回款库存量时间状态_E112.json"
original_rows=read(parent_path)["rows"]
assert len(original_rows)==79
cases=[]
for idx in (0,len(original_rows)//2,len(original_rows)-1):
    r=original_rows[idx]
    cutoff=datetime.fromisoformat(r["same_original_cutoff"])
    current_quarter=(cutoff.month-1)//3+1
    target_year=cutoff.year if current_quarter>1 else cutoff.year-1
    target_quarter=current_quarter-1 if current_quarter>1 else 4
    label={1:"一",2:"二",3:"三",4:"四"}[target_quarter]
    cases.append({
        "original_sequence_idx":r["original_sequence_idx"],"economic_period":r["economic_period"],
        "same_original_cutoff":r["same_original_cutoff"],
        "fixed_target_loan_stat_quarter":f"{target_year}Q{target_quarter}",
        "quarter_selection_rule":"按最早/中间/末端三个原身份截止前最近已经结束的完整自然季度固定；另核自己的公布钟，晚到则未知，不降到其他季度或选有源季度。",
        "same_original_operating_joint_cell":r["current_joint_cell"],
        "q":f"{target_year}年 {label}季度 金融机构贷款投向统计报告",
        "domains":["pbc.gov.cn","gov.cn"],
        "cached_original_available_in_direct_prior_route":False
    })
assert [r["fixed_target_loan_stat_quarter"] for r in cases]==["2018Q3","2022Q1","2025Q3"]
legacy_paths=[
"reports/research/510300_historical_index_credit_realization_v1/protocol.json",
"reports/research/510300_historical_index_credit_realization_v1/result.json",
"reports/research/510300_historical_index_credit_realization_v1/loan_purpose.json",
"reports/research/510300_historical_index_credit_realization_v1/source_manifest.json",
"research/historical_index_credit_realization_v1.py",
"reports/research/510300_loan_maturity_composition_daily_v1/protocol.json",
"reports/research/510300_loan_maturity_composition_daily_v1/result.json",
"research/loan_maturity_composition_daily_v1.py",
"reports/research/510300_credit_recency_structure_v23/protocol.json",
"reports/research/510300_credit_recency_structure_v23/verification.json",
"research/credit_recency_structure_v23.py",
"config/510300_original_quarterly_flow_policy_v1.json",
"reports/research/510300_original_quarterly_flow_policy_v1/result.json",
"research/original_quarterly_flow_policy_v1.py",
"reports/research/510300_bank_profit_credit_bridge_v13/protocol.json",
"reports/research/510300_bank_profit_credit_bridge_v13/result.json"
]
parents=[{"path":rel(p),"sha256":sha(p)} for p in (proposal_path,prev_path,parent_path)]
parents.extend({"path":p,"sha256":sha(root/p)} for p in legacy_paths)
legacy_maturity=read(root/"reports/research/510300_loan_maturity_composition_daily_v1/result.json")
legacy_purpose=read(root/"reports/research/510300_historical_index_credit_realization_v1/result.json")
prior_review=save("贷款投向实际旧用途与非新方向边界_E114.json",{
    "at":now(),
    "previous_goal_turn":{"experiment_id":"E113","classification":"PROGRESS","actual_result":{"path":rel(prev_path),"sha256":sha(prev_path)}},
    "legacy_actual_allocation":{
        "study_id":legacy_purpose["study_id"],"status":legacy_purpose["status"],
        "quarterly_sources_previously_read":["2022Q3","2022Q4","2023Q1"],
        "old_source_fields":["企事业中长期","工业中长期","基础设施中长期","固定资产贷款","房地产贷款合计","房地产开发贷款","个人住房贷款","住户贷款合计","住户经营贷款","住户非住房消费贷款"],
        "old_financial_model_or_full_account_for_that_study":False,
        "old_fact":"用途/期限/渠道、经营贷款与消费贷款及最终需求已经分开；不是首次发现这些经济区别。",
        "new_field_name_is_novel_information":False,
        "scope_difference_under_review":"当前固定三原身份对应三个未在该旧三季度案例里的统计原季度；只核原母体/定义/完整稿/自己时钟，并连接原79共同经营背景，不据此申报新金融信息。"
    },
    "legacy_monthly_maturity":{
        "study_id":legacy_maturity["study_id"],"status":legacy_maturity["status"],
        "main_stress_sharpe":legacy_maturity["primary"]["sharpe"],
        "main_stress_cagr":legacy_maturity["primary"]["annual_return"],
        "main_max_drawdown":legacy_maturity["primary"]["max_drawdown"],
        "field":"企业与居民中长期年初累计净增合计/人民币贷款累计净增",
        "same_frozen_financial_use_reopened":False,
        "allocation_quarter_is_not_same_monthly_ratio":True
    },
    "other_direct_legacy_boundaries":"V23累计及近期期限支持已有解释；季度原资金流主策略已未达标，银行信用盈利桥为旧个股解释，不扩展当前个股主线。",
    "old_saved_performance_reports_read_for_prior_use":True,
    "current_fixed79_stock_labels_read":False,
    "new_financial_information_admitted":False,"financial_candidates":0,
    "local_prior_review_is_bounded_not_entire_repo_exhaustive":True,
    "source_probe_permitted_only_for_economic_contract_and_same_cutoff_background":True,
    "legacy_economic_discovery_is_not_financial_rejection_of_allocation_family":True,
    "parents":parents
})
protocol={
    "experiment_id":"E114","study_id":"510300_ACTUAL_LOAN_ALLOCATION_PRIOR_USE_SOURCE_V1",
    "registered_at":now(),"status":"REGISTERED_THREE_FIXED_ORIGINAL_QUARTERS_BEFORE_NEW_QUERIES",
    "question":"实际贷款投向的原数量与借款主体/期限如何与原同钟资金价格、订单、工业利润和应收库存占用并存？这些公开统计能说明什么、不能说明什么？",
    "role":"固定来源样例和原共同经营背景解释，不是新的金融候选或全部原成员金融准入。",
    "prior_use_review":prior_review,"fixed_cases":cases,"parents":parents,
    "selection_rule":"各原季度一次固定定位，按搜索返回顺序选首个对应原统计年的全国完整金融机构贷款投向报告；允许人民银行原稿或明确全文转载的政府站原页。必须涵盖全国贷款总量和企事业/工业中长期、住户、房地产等原主要门类；排除新闻摘录、机构评论、地方自身统计、目录、其他季度或年度总稿。选后只首GET，不失败后换载体。",
    "reuse_rule":"已取得同原完整响应可按原sha复用并保留其首次取得/转载上界；有限旧三季度案例无本次三个季度，不能以其他季度数据补。",
    "clock_rule":"从每原页明确PubDate或原正文头的公开日期/时刻取得自己钟；只有日期保守日末。政府全文转载只保守转载公开上界，不称最早PBOC发布，须早于原共同截止。成文/取得/URL不能补原钟，历史首版未认证。",
    "complete_source_rule":"取得并保存原完整正文、全部原表与附注、来源/标题/自己公开钟、范围与方法；移动或桌面同文副本不计独立来源，受阻/目录/错误期不作量合格。",
    "quantity_contract":{
        "balances":"原期末余额、币种、借款主体和期限，不是当期新发放或可用现金。",
        "growth_and_net_increase":"同比增速与年内净增分别记录；净增包含发放、偿还、核销及调整的合成，未拆出新发放/滚续则UNKNOWN。",
        "population":"本外币与人民币、企事业/机关团体与工业/制造业/基础设施/房地产/住户等不同或交叉总体，不混币种相加或套指数权重。",
        "purpose":"长期借款和固定资产/工业投向不证明资金已转为新增投资、最终需求或股票买盘；房地产开发与住房按揭/居民经营和消费保留不同。",
        "survey":"银行家需求/审批调查意见、银行利润率与真实投向数量不是互换数据。",
        "ratios":"原稿未直接报告的比重或未对齐同币种母体不合成；当前不设计入模衍生值。"
    },
    "joint_cause_rule":"固定三例都保留E112同一原截止的完整价格、资金价量、订单、收入利润、应收回收、库存周转、有年龄基金与原范围；贷款统计自己的范围/年龄分开。每例最多一个主要机制/共同事实与两个竞争解释，不读取其后的股市标签。",
    "limits":{"fixed_new_queries":3,"maximum_distinct_first_raw_GETs":3,"GET_concurrency_max":3,"connect_timeout_seconds":12,"read_timeout_seconds":30,"TLS_verify":True,"retries":0,"alternate_carriers":0,"extra_queries":0,"authenticated_requests":0},
    "financial_budget":{"new_financial_candidates":0,"new_model_fits":0,"new_linear_regressions":0,"new_simple_weighted_scores":0,"new_stock_labels_generated":0,"new_full_accounts":0,"existing_source_code_edits":0},
    "original79_1711_1212_preserved":True,
    "all_original_mature_member_source_gate_established_by_three_examples":False,
    "new_financial_information_qualification":"NOT_ESTABLISHED",
    "old_monthly_maturity_macro_surprise_bank_demand_approval_quarter_flow_failures_preserved":True,
    "closed_E113_E109_E108_E111_sources_not_retried":True,
    "DR007_no_account_no_authenticated_request":True,
    "historical_first_vintage_authenticated":False,"independent_validation":False,
    "goal_status":"active","goal_achieved":False,"net_sharpe":"NOT_COMPUTED",
    "current_view":"NO_VIEW","position":"UNSET","orders_authorized":False,"prospective_forecasts":False
}
ref=save("protocol.json",protocol)
tracked=subprocess.run(["git","status","--short","--untracked-files=no"],capture_output=True,text=True,encoding="utf-8",check=True).stdout
branch=subprocess.run(["git","branch","--show-current"],capture_output=True,text=True,encoding="utf-8",check=True).stdout.strip()
head=subprocess.run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],capture_output=True,text=True,encoding="utf-8",check=True).stdout.strip()
save("运行前git记录_E114.json",{"at":now(),"branch":branch,"HEAD":head,"tracked_status":tracked,"preexisting_tracked_changes":len(tracked.splitlines())})
print(json.dumps({"protocol":ref,"fixed_cases":cases,"old_purpose_role_already_observed":True,"new_financial_info_admitted":False,"new_model_fits":0,"previous_goal_turn":"PROGRESS_E113"},ensure_ascii=False))
